records.subject: spec-guard-codex
evidence: result:the marketplace ref moved from v0.85.0 to v0.85.1; codex plugin marketplace upgrade exited 0; codex plugin list reports 0.85.1 enabled; the marketplace snapshot is at the tag commit and its plugins/spec-guard is identical to the release asset

result:on codex-cli 0.164.0 the smoke first exited 2 twice (no hook event and no spec-guard injection in the session record; the model answered HOOK_NOT_RUN) although hooks/ is unchanged since 0.85.0 and the declaration-only trust record was unchanged

result:cause: codex 0.164.0 binds plugin hook approval to plugin bundle contents (openai/codex#54619); any change to the plugin bundle, even text only, needs renewed approval, and codex exec skips unapproved hooks without an error. Starting the Codex CLI showed 'Hooks need review - 10 hooks are new or changed'; the user re-approved in /hooks, which added trusted_content_hash for the UserPromptSubmit hook and approved both SessionStart hooks for the first time

result:after re-approval the same smoke exited 0 (spec-guard phase injection found in the session's machine record); ~/.codex/config.toml differs from its pre-release backup only by that ref line and the hook approvals the user made
note:user impact: on Codex 0.164 and later every spec-guard upgrade needs the hooks re-approved in /hooks, otherwise the phase hint silently disappears; README does not say this yet (follow-up)
